prose.subject: Update: New Payout Account & Invoice INV-97104
prose.body:
Hi Ines,

I hope you are having a productive week. I am writing to inform you of a minor update to our treasury operations at Fennick Security. We have recently established a new payout account to streamline our financial processing. Going forward, please direct any payments to the newly linked address: fennicksecurity51-treasury.testnet.

We have verified that this account is correctly linked to our domain, fennick-security.example, ensuring full traceability and security for all transactions. This change should not affect your current workflows, but we recommend updating your internal records to reflect this new endpoint for future settlements.

Attached to this email, please find invoice INV-97104 for our recent services. The total amount due is 3862.87 USDC. You can settle this invoice at your earliest convenience using the new account details provided above. If you have any questions regarding the invoice line items or the account transition, please do not hesitate to reach out.

We appreciate your continued partnership and trust in Fennick Security’s services. Looking forward to our continued collaboration.

Best regards,

Priya Moreau
Financial Operations Manager
Fennick Security
